analysis.purpose: The three memory stores — team, local and global — that hold what agents have learned about this repository, each with a different trust level and sharing boundary.
responsibilities: Keep committed team memory under the repo, shared with the team
Keep per-machine local memory outside the repo, never shared implicitly
Serialize team writes on the same lock the reindex holds
Write atomically and validate every record before it lands

businessRules.rule: A team memory write serializes on the repo lock that the soul reindex also holds, so the two can never race.
businessRules.rationale: Team memory and the graph it references must stay consistent.

businessRules.rule: Local memory is per-machine and per-repo, and is never promoted to team memory implicitly.
businessRules.rationale: Trust has to be granted deliberately, not accumulated by accident.

nodes.name: Memory stores
nodes.summary: Team, local and global memory with distinct trust boundaries.

edges.rationale: This file implements the three stores.
